settings/sleepOnExit.title: Sleep on exit
settings/sleepOnExit.body: Put the PlayStation console into rest mode when you leave a Remote Play session.

settings/connectedControllers.title: Connected controllers
settings/connectedControllers.body: Open per-controller output, lightbar, haptics, and rumble settings. Wake a controller first so Akira can detect it.

settings/buttonMapping.title: Button mapping
settings/buttonMapping.body: Open the button-remapping screen for Remote Play controls.
